issue.title: Day strip typical day — a quiet reference line under each numeric fact
issue.description: Under Worked, Reviewed, Done, and Created, every Day strip shows one quiet line with that metric's typical day: the median of the seven days before D, needing at least four days with data. On finished days a neutral ▲, ▼, or = mark comes first, so the line reads `▼ typical 4h 10m`. Today shows `typical 4h 10m` with no mark. bob computes every number and word in a new additive `typical` object on day-grouped JSON points, and the plugin only paints it. The line has no colour, no percentages, and no bars. The strip never changes height when data arrives. The decision is recorded so no future agent "fixes" it back out.

issue.description: strip-line: in bob-plugins bob-ledger-tools, build a pure `ref` model from `point.typical` and paint an aria-hidden reference line with SVG ▲/▼/= marks on every fact. Extend the unit tests and the preview harness (new states, alignment, clipping, contrast, measured budgets). Update the plugin docs and the bob-cli Day strip contract, bump the plugin version, then sync.
